description: The stable root node of one JSON document. Scalar JSON is stored as text so durable snapshots remain number-free.

columns.name: empty_json
columns.description: Exact whitespace inside an empty root object or array. Omitted for non-empty containers and scalars.

columns.name: id
columns.description: The constant identity of the document root.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: The JSON node kind. Object and array roots carry their content in child rows.

columns.name: prefix_json
columns.description: Exact outer JSON whitespace before the root value. Omitted when empty.

columns.name: scalar_json
columns.description: The complete raw JSON scalar encoded as text. Omitted for object and array roots.

columns.name: suffix_json
columns.description: Exact outer JSON whitespace after the root value. Omitted when empty.
